age.Description: Age of the participant at time of testing

descriptive_SOZ.Description: Seizure Onset Zone of the participant

SOZ_laterality.Description: Seizure Onset Zone hemisphere. R for right, L for left

SOZ_region.Description: Seizure Onset Zone lobe (eg. temporal, frontal) or region (eg. insula)

TimeFromSleepOnset.Description: Time from sleep onset in minutes

SleepScoring.Description: Sleep stages according to AASM criteria in 30s epochs

SOZ.Description: Seizure onset zone (free text, as provided by the authors; README: 'SOZ: Seizure onset zone').

recorded_regions.Description: Brain regions with depth electrodes for this patient (row labels with "V" in the patient's column), verbatim, Falach et al. 2024 Sci Data 11:1354 doi:10.1038/s41597-024-04187-y Table 1 "Recorded regions" (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-024-04187-y/tables/1). Patient columns 1-25 = sub-01..sub-25 (checked against the channel labels for entorhinal cortex, parahippocampal gyrus and occipital lobe in all 25 subjects, 0 disagreements).
